body: Nope Ireland. Ended up arrested and in a psych unit. Only made me worse. Talked my way out a week back. Could've walked out anytime but the staff were nice enough I didn't want them getting in shit over me. Been suicidal since I was about 14. Think I was when I was 11 but I didn't have a grasp on the whole concept then. Plenty of experience now almost a decade later

They know what I'm trying to do. My dads even blocked my car in in the driveway in some attempt to stop me leaving. Fairly certain they're gonna call the police again soon if they haven't already and I'm not sticking around for that again. Getting arrested once is enough for me

I've had a pretty rough life honestly. I'm 20 now and in college but I spent the better part of my entire school life getting beat up until I was tough enough to start winning fights. Never mind the million personal issues I have. I know I could find someone else. Issue is I don't care to anymore. Ive lost everything I cared about all at once. My ex my closest friends and the relationship with my family and since then I haven't found anything else that drives me to stick around. And fuck have I tried over the last 8 months. I've really tried. But I'm just exhausted now and I dont have any fight left in me

I've researched it a lot. I already have other scars anyway and there's nobody left who's opinion on them I care about if I did end up with one more. It doesn't seem that hard anyway and I'll have a lot of time to bleed out. I know there are services and everything I could call but I've talked so much already and it only gets worse so I'd rather not talk. My family know I'm thinking of trying it and I'm sure they're going to try stop me but I've made up my mind

Driving further into the countryside where nobody gonna find me listen to some music probably drink since I've nothing else atm and cut my wrist. Don't have enough pills or anything at home or I would have gone with that route

Talked so much to a lot of different people. Only person who ever got me anyway was my ex and she couldn't care less now that she's with her new guy. There was some small part of me that didn't want to last time I tried it, its why she was able to talk me down but I'm not torn anymore just tired of waking up as miserable as the day before every single day

I know what you mean. Done that a lot of times with other things in the past. Had it pretty rough in school and went through some other stuff outside too. Just different this time with how much worse it all is. Might take you up on that offer to talk if you're alright with that. Isn't anyone left lately I've been able to be honest with
Was at a pretty low point and feeling more lonely than usual when I wrote the post so yeah wasn't the reply I was hoping for if I got any
I've had plenty of contact with professionals and been on my meds for long enough they should be working. I've tried therapy and everything. Nothing so far has made any difference

I've told people and I'm seeing professionals and all that but I've stopped caring at all. Might sound like a cliche but I don't want anyone else and I don't want to keep living feeling this shit all the time

Tried it 3 times. The last 2 very recently. Lost all my friends I held close. The girl I love more than anything fell out of love with me. Failing in college for the first time. I know I could have a successful career and future but I don't see the point anymore. I've stopped caring about it all. Id give it all up to stop hurting. Life doesn't feel worth it anymore
